From d7f14173c0d5866c3cae759dee560ad1bed10d2e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Daniel Borkmann <daniel@iogearbox.net>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 21:24:18 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] bpf: Fix linked reg delta tracking when src_reg == dst_reg

Consider the case of rX += rX where src_reg and dst_reg are pointers to
the same bpf_reg_state in adjust_reg_min_max_vals(). The latter first
modifies the dst_reg in-place, and later in the delta tracking, the
subsequent is_reg_const(src_reg)/reg_const_value(src_reg) reads the
post-{add,sub} value instead of the original source.

This is problematic since it sets an incorrect delta, which sync_linked_regs()
then propagates to linked registers, thus creating a verifier-vs-runtime
mismatch. Fix it by just skipping this corner case.

Fixes: 98d7ca374ba4 ("bpf: Track delta between "linked" registers.")
Reported-by: STAR Labs SG <info@starlabs.sg>
Signed-off-by: Daniel Borkmann <daniel@iogearbox.net>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20260407192421.508817-1-daniel@iogearbox.net
Signed-off-by: Alexei Starovoitov <ast@kernel.org>

diff --git a/kernel/bpf/verifier.c b/kernel/bpf/verifier.c
index 1bebbdb3b693..d83e17cccd38 100644
--- a/kernel/bpf/verifier.c
+++ b/kernel/bpf/verifier.c
@@ -16722,7 +16722,8 @@ static int adjust_reg_min_max_vals(struct bpf_verifier_env *env,
 	 */
 	if (env->bpf_capable &&
 	    (BPF_OP(insn->code) == BPF_ADD || BPF_OP(insn->code) == BPF_SUB) &&
-	    dst_reg->id && is_reg_const(src_reg, alu32)) {
+	    dst_reg->id && is_reg_const(src_reg, alu32) &&
+	    !(BPF_SRC(insn->code) == BPF_X && insn->src_reg == insn->dst_reg)) {
 		u64 val = reg_const_value(src_reg, alu32);
 		s32 off;
 
-- 
2.34.1

### Summary of Modifications

#### File: `kernel/bpf/verifier.c`
- **Function**: `adjust_reg_min_max_vals()`
- **Change**: Added an extra condition to an existing `if` statement that handles delta tracking for linked registers.

**Before the patch**:
```c
if (env->bpf_capable &&
    (BPF_OP(insn->code) == BPF_ADD || BPF_OP(insn->code) == BPF_SUB) &&
    dst_reg->id && is_reg_const(src_reg, alu32)) {
```
**After the patch**:
```c
if (env->bpf_capable &&
    (BPF_OP(insn->code) == BPF_ADD || BPF_OP(insn->code) == BPF_SUB) &&
    dst_reg->id && is_reg_const(src_reg, alu32) &&
    !(BPF_SRC(insn->code) == BPF_X && insn->src_reg == insn->dst_reg)) {
```

The additional `!(BPF_SRC(insn->code) == BPF_X && insn->src_reg == insn->dst_reg)` condition ensures that the delta tracking logic is **skipped** when the instruction is of the form `rX += rX` (or `rX -= rX`), i.e., when the source and destination registers are the same.

### Relationship Between Modifications
- The bug occurs because when `src_reg == dst_reg`, the in-place modification of `dst_reg` (done earlier during arithmetic evaluation) overwrites the original source value. The subsequent call to `is_reg_const(src_reg, alu32)` then reads the **post-operation** value instead of the original constant, leading to an incorrect delta calculation. This incorrect delta is then propagated to linked registers via `sync_linked_regs()`, causing a verifier-vs-runtime mismatch.
- The fix simply prevents the delta tracking from occurring in this specific corner case, avoiding the race condition entirely. No other parts of the code are affected.
